statement: For sufficiently weak iid centered variance-one potential on Z^3, an open energy region has absolutely continuous spectrum, and finite-volume eigenvalues in a bulk window have GOE local statistics.
assumptions: Intake C0056 wording; distribution and GOE convergence mode unspecified in intake
proof_or_counterexample: No proof in intake. Bourgade 2018 poses the two pieces separately.
remaining_gap: Specify law, energy interval, boundary conditions, and GOE convergence; verify 2026 a.c. preprint and any GOE result.

statement: For a real, b>0 and lambda>0, with f(v)=b/[pi*((lambda*v-a)^2+b^2)], integral_R f(v)log(1+f(v))dv=(2/lambda)log((1+sqrt(1+1/(pi*b)))/2).
proof_or_counterexample: Substitute t=(lambda*v-a)/b; differentiate I(c)=integral log(1+c/(1+t^2))/(1+t^2)dt, obtaining I'(c)=pi/c*(1-1/sqrt(1+c)), then integrate from c=0.
remaining_gap: No gap in integral identity; it does not establish the (LG) cavity estimate.

statement: If for the infinite-volume iid uniform[-1,1] Anderson cavity at fixed lambda>0 an eta_n down to zero satisfies sup_n int_I E[b(E,eta_n)^(-1)]dE<infinity, then almost surely the spectral restriction to bounded open I is purely absolutely continuous.
assumptions: Z^3 nearest-neighbor H; independent uniform single-site law; b=eta+Im cavity self-energy; fixed lambda and infinite volume
proof_or_counterexample: Conditional E[(Im G00)^2|cavity]<=pi/(4 lambda b). Fatou gives finite liminf of L2 resolvent norms a.s.; Riesz representation on C_c(I) identifies an L2 spectral density. Countable site basis gives operator purity.
remaining_gap: The inverse-b input M is unproved. Nonzero window mass follows separately from w480 L5, not from M alone. No GOE result.

statement: For H=-A+lambda V on l2(Z^3) with iid uniform[-1,1] V_x and fixed lambda>0, if sup_0<eta<=1 E int_J log(1+1/b_x(E,eta))dE is finite for every site x, where b_x=eta+Im<h_x,(H^(x)-E-i eta)^(-1)h_x>, then almost surely every local spectral measure restricted to bounded open J is absolutely continuous.
assumptions: Infinite-volume self-adjoint cavity, fixed lambda, J bounded open, (LG) as stated
proof_or_counterexample: Schur complement and R1 bound the entropy integral by (2 lambda)^(-1) times (LG); Dunford-Pettis weak L1 compactness on Omega x J plus Poisson weak convergence identifies random spectral measures with L1 densities.
remaining_gap: (LG) is unproved for weak-disorder Z^3; w485 must audit the conditional implication.

statement: An annealed first-moment bound on Im G00 cannot alone imply quenched absolutely continuous site spectrum.
assumptions: Diagonal iid uniform[-1,1] operator D on l2(Z^3), eta>0
proof_or_counterexample: mu_0=delta_X0; E Im G00<=pi/2, integral_R Im G00=pi, yet every realization is pure point. For p>1 the expected Lp integral on [-1,1] is at least 2^-p eta^(1-p).
remaining_gap: Only rejects the abstract first-moment inference, not the nearest-neighbor weak-disorder target.
